name: fire roasted meatballs
instructions:
Real meatballs in a crushed-tomato sauce. The meatballs are a classic panade build — GROUND BEEF + STALE BREAD soaked in MILK + PARSLEY — and the sauce base is CRUSHED TOMATOES or CRUSHED FIRE-ROASTED TOMATOES, sharpened with RED WINE VINEGAR and OREGANO.

=== THE MEATBALLS ===

- ground beef
- stale bread, soaked in milk (the panade — squeeze/break into the meat)
- fresh parsley, chopped
- salt and black pepper

Mix, shape into meatballs, and brown in olive oil.

=== THE SAUCE ===

- crushed tomatoes OR crushed fire-roasted tomatoes
- red wine vinegar
- oregano

Add the sauce components to the browned meatballs and simmer until thickened.

=== SERVE ===

Toss with pasta.
notes:
=== TOTAL REWRITE (SEPTEMBER 2026) — NOW A REAL MEATBALL RECIPE ===

Rewritten from the old impossible-meat version into a real meatball recipe: ground beef with a milk-soaked stale-bread panade and parsley. The old build (impossible meat, fennel seeds, bay leaf, fire-roasted-only tomatoes) survives in git history.

=== THE PANADE — STALE BREAD + MILK ===

Stale bread soaked in milk is what keeps the meatballs tender — the classic italian-american move. Parsley is the herb inside the meatball.

=== SAUCE — CRUSHED TOMATOES, FIRE-ROASTED OPTIONAL ===

Crushed tomatoes are the base; crushed FIRE-ROASTED tomatoes are the equally valid smoky direction (the recipe's namesake). Red wine vinegar and oregano are both primary — the vinegar sharpens the sauce, the oregano is the herb axis on the sauce side (parsley lives inside the meatballs).

=== SIBLING RECIPES ===

- [[bolognese]]: the other ragu — ground meat loose in the sauce rather than shaped. The meatball-per-forkful format is what this recipe is for.
- [[marcella-gnocchi-sauce]]: the protein-free tomato-sauce side of the family.
